rag.text:
Test: TC-423 — Box Module - Risk - Column View - Risk Table Column display options
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-105 Box Module - Risk - Column Views
Labels: teamsource

Steps:
1. Navigate to Risks module in boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-423 View modes in Risks matrix
   Expected: Risks module is displayed. Essentials Column View is selected.
2. Click on Table button
   Expected: Risk table is displayed.
3. Grab the border between column1 and column2, move to the right  and release it

Refresh the page
   Data: column1: Key
column2: Summary
   Expected: Border is moved and columns are resized
4. Grab the border between column1 and column2 and narrow the column1 to the minimum
   Data: column1: Assignee
column2: Status
   Expected: Columns are resized.
5. Hover over columnName
   Data: columnName: Assignee
   Expected: Tooltip with whole column name is displayed above the column.
6. Grab the column1 and release it between column2 and column3.
   Data: column1: Assignee
column2: Issue type
column3: Key
   Expected: Column is displayed between Risk robability and Risk consequence
7. Hover over columnName
   Data: columnName: Risk probability
   Expected: Customize column wrench icon appears next to column name
8. Click on wrench icon
   Expected: Additional window to change display setting appears
9. Select displayOption
   Data: displayOption: Text
   Expected: Display settings are changed. Risk probability values are displayed as plain text
